races.paceDynamic: Master Haku and The Store Boy will contest the early lead in this 17-runner maiden hurdle, with both having prominent tendencies and proven ability at this level. The pace should be genuine but not destructive given the distance and the fact these are the only two with clear front-running credentials among a field dominated by hold-up horses. With 13 hold-up performers including several lightly-raced newcomers, the race will likely develop into a tactical affair before a scramble in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters who can maintain their position, as the hold-up brigade will struggle to organize their challenges effectively in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Master Haku and The Store Boy maintain their early advantage without destructive pace pressure
scenarios.body: The proven pair can capitalize on their class edge over the largely inexperienced field behind. Jack Kennedy's tactical nous on Master Haku becomes decisive as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and the leaders tire in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The experienced hold-up performers like Phoenix Arizona and Endless Talking can time their runs perfectly as the pace collapses. The large field creates cover for patient tactics to pay dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants or lightly-raced runners possesses hidden ability above their rating
scenarios.body: The newcomers from powerful connections like Elliott's Misery Hill or Cromwell's Blues Street could have been working better than their OR suggests. Their fresh legs and unknown potential become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly steady and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint from the final hurdle with positioning becoming critical. Jockey experience and horse acceleration matter more than early tactical position.

races.paceDynamic: Jazz Forever will take the field along at a controlled tempo with Desert Haven, Lady Doyanne and Jury Belle settling prominently behind the leader. The sustainable early pace will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses including Kabylia, Jerrari, and Spinning Web to settle comfortably in behind. Jazz Forever's tendency to fade in the finish means the pace will likely collapse in the final half-mile, setting up a cavalry charge from the rear. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever sets his usual controlled pace and fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The collapsing pace allows the talented hold-up brigade to unleash telling finishes from the back of the field. Class horses like Kabylia and Jerrari can use their proven finishing kicks to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Doyanne or Desert Haven can slip the field turning for home while Jazz Forever weakens
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Lady Doyanne's class and Desert Haven's consistent form make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jazz Forever Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the leader finds more stamina than recent form suggests and maintains his gallop to the line
scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalizes on soft fractions to steal a march on his pursuers in the closing stages. His early advantage proves insurmountable despite his finishing concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to take up the running early and they crawl through the first mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical position matters more than stamina, suiting those drawn well and ridden patiently. The lack of pace exposure favours the freshest finishers.

races.paceDynamic: Krishna Bellevue is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and will dictate terms from the outset over 2m3f at Kilbeggan. Mon Sheriffe may press early from a prominent position, but the lack of natural pace setters means Krishna Bellevue can control fractions without pressure through the early stages. With 17 hold-up horses needing to find gaps and make ground late, the race will develop into a tactical affair with a strong finishing kick required. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the modest early pace and kick clear before the cavalry charge arrives from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Krishna Bellevue maintains control without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The modest gallop allows prominent runners to stay in touch and time their challenge perfectly before the hold-up brigade can organize. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground from too far back when the pace lifts late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly pedestrian and hold-up horses get perfect runs
scenarios.body: The crawling pace allows class horses to unleash devastating late kicks with clear passages through the field. Premium hold-up performers with tactical speed can capitalize on perfect positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Krishna Bellevue faces minimal early pressure and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The lack of early harassment allows the leader to build an unassailable advantage that holds despite late challenges. Prominent runners provide the main threats but fall just short of the wire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Krishna Bellevue fades dramatically in the final furlong as warned
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes stop-start when the leader hits the wall, creating a messy finish where any hold-up horse with a clear run can capitalize. The race becomes a lottery of who gets the best passage through traffic.

races.paceDynamic: Gino Bella will likely lead from the front with no genuine pace pressure, as most runners prefer to sit off the pace with hold-up tactics. Hidalgo Des Mottes, Bowgate Street, and potentially Crafty Gael may track in prominent positions, but the majority of this 19-runner field consists of hold-up horses who will be positioned in midfield or further back. With such a large field and minimal early pace pressure, Gino Bella can dictate fractions and kick for home when ready. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and horses with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face traffic problems and may struggle to make up significant ground from the back of such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gino Bella Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Gino Bella gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The leader can quicken off steady splits while the mass of hold-up horses struggle with traffic and ground to make up. Prominent trackers like Hidalgo Des Mottes and Bowgate Street are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners successfully stalks Gino Bella and times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The tactical pace allows stalkers to conserve energy before unleashing a telling move, while hold-up horses remain too far back in the large field. Hidalgo Des Mottes or Bowgate Street can use their positioning advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong early or the field spreads out more than expected
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse with a strong turn of foot can weave through and strike late when others have emptied their tanks. Jaadil's class or Jinxs Link's experience could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Gino Bella goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where any horse with a clean run and fresh legs can prevail. The race becomes a lottery with multiple chances for different profiles.

races.paceDynamic: Made In The Woods is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable tempo without early pressure in this 19-runner field. The prominent runners It's Time Again, Plain Or Battered, Sean Mc, Mr Dibbs and Coppola will track within striking distance but unlikely to engage early over this extended 3m½f trip. This creates a tactical race where the pace will be steady early before quickening from 3 furlongs out, with the winner coming from the large hold-up contingent. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, as the early pace will be too slow to tire the field sufficiently for front runners to prosper.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods sets an uncontested lead with steady fractions through the early stages
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow to string out the field properly, allowing the superior hold-up performers to unleash devastating late runs. Quality closers like Live To Laugh and Midleton Rare will have too much finishing speed for the early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If It's Time Again and Sean Mc track closer than usual and apply pressure from 4 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field more than expected, preventing the hold-up horses from getting into contention. Those positioned prominently can kick clear before the closers can respond effectively.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods gets soft early fractions and the field fails to organize a strong challenge
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to resist late challenges, particularly with his fitness edge and light weight advantage. Several hold-up horses fail to get competitive positions or produce their usual finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes exceptionally slow with multiple horses still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of running style, with the winner determined by who gets the clearest run. Horses with recent form and tactical speed become crucial rather than natural finishers.

races.paceDynamic: Hitthehayson, Tell Nobody Nothin, Doyen Magic and Marelly will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with multiple confirmed pace-setters creating sustained pressure throughout. The strong early tempo will test stamina reserves over this 2m4f trip on Good To Yielding ground, particularly through the middle stages where the pace is likely to remain honest. With four natural front-runners and several prominent racers like Stoneyford Lady and Sampoet pushing forward, the pace will be relentless. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and patient tactical rides, as the early burn will set up the race for closers with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and multiple pace-setters crack turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will empty the tanks of front-runners, allowing patient hold-up horses to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Class horses like Duffys Hodey and Iamagetaway with Jack Kennedy can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters moderate slightly and save enough for a battle
scenarios.body: Hitthehayson and Doyen Magic can sustain their effort better than the others, while prominent racers like Stoneyford Lady can bridge the gap. The race becomes more about class than stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout and only true stayers survive
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will find out every horse's stamina, with only the most patient rides and strongest stayers able to quicken late. Musta Lovea Lovea's stamina could be underestimated.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple leaders stop quickly and create a messy finish with no clear pace
scenarios.body: The race fragments completely with tired horses struggling home, allowing any horse with a bit left to pick up the pieces. Outsiders with fresh legs could capitalise.

watchPoints.text: Multiple pace-setters Hitthehayson, Tell Nobody Nothin, Doyen Magic and Marelly will create unsustainable early fractions that could collapse the entire field
Stoneyford Lady returning from 119-day break may need the run despite Henry De Bromhead's preparation skills
Iamagetaway has been off for 191 days but Jack Kennedy's booking suggests Gordon Elliott believes he's ready
The claiming jockeys on Sampoet and Justabitofyours may struggle with tactical decisions in such a competitive handicap
Riyami switching back to jumps after flat racing stint with Sean Flanagan taking the ride signals intention
